finalText:
Migrated 36 call sites across 12 files; all syntax-check clean.

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| accounts | `repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js` |
| billing | `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js` |
| catalog | `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js` |
| orders | `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js` |
| support | `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js` |
| analytics | `repo/cohort.js` |

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13`** — still on `db.query`. Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade, with local edits silently lost. Migrating it there would be reverted by the next upgrade. Since `lib/db.js` says the driver's next major *drops* `query`, this needs a real fix: upstream the change, pin a patched fork, or wrap the adapter locally. Your call which — say the word and I'll do it.
- **`cache.query(...)`** in the repo files — that's `lib/cache.js`, a different object, out of scope.

`lib/db.js` still exports the deprecated `query` method, which is what keeps the vendor file working. Leave it until the vendor situation is resolved.
